claim: Actual projective Scheme morphism of global bicanonical q0/q1, rational independence, and exact rank-sixteen t-chart/generic-degree certificate
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing
external_input_scope: No new literature theorem. Pinned Mathlib open-cover gluing and actual frozen algebra/Scheme/sheaf producers are consumed.

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: A generating pair on an actual rank-one sheaf, actual open-cover gluing, and valid degree/independence inputs are required.
obligations.constructed: The frozen actual global q0/q1 and every-subopen generation theorems are consumed. All twists remain rational units.
obligations.why_match: Only the everywhere-unit coefficient is divided out. The Scheme maps are glued on the actual five-chart cover after categorical overlap compatibility is proved.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: The map must be constructed from the actual global intrinsic bicanonical pair on the actual complete contact normalization.
obligations.constructed: Ratio sections live in the actual structure sheaf; local polynomial evaluations and projective chart inclusions give Scheme morphisms. projectiveMap is their actual glueMorphisms.
obligations.why_match: Global ratio equations literally mention ContactGlobalBicanonical318.q0 and q1. The pair is not replaced by a coordinate pair on another model.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: Every chart and point, including all four finite branches and infinity, must be covered.
obligations.constructed: The localMap index is Option(Fin4), with every some i and none handled; the prior exact cover is reused.
obligations.why_match: The compatibility proof is for every pair of chart indices on categorical pullbacks, and cover gluing returns a map on the entire source.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: Signs, scalars, reciprocal conventions and the global map comparison must be exact.
obligations.constructed: Finite q1/q0 equals t; infinity q0/q1 equals u²/c0. The latter is the literal image of the reciprocal base coordinate under chartMap.
obligations.why_match: branch_polynomial and infinity_polynomial compare full polynomial ring homomorphisms. Their Scheme squares prove actual map equality by open-cover extensionality, rather than agreement on selected points.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: The degree and independence assertions must concern the newly constructed map and the actual pair.
obligations.constructed: The degree module uses projectiveMap in the exact t-chart cartesian square. The independence module uses the literal global q0/q1 and constants from the actual structureMap.
obligations.why_match: The rank-sixteen SourceOrder is the entire base change of this map, and its specified generic fiber is the existing original full field. Independence is derived by restricting those same global sections.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: The scalar field, homogeneous coordinate order and inverse-twist powers must match.
obligations.constructed: Everything is over Q; twists are Q-units; u=c0/y0; the map has coordinates [q1:q0]. Constants are the structure-map ring homomorphism from Q.
obligations.why_match: The infinity coefficient identity proves the exact c0 inverse factor before defining the ratio map. The rational independence action is explicit, avoiding an unrelated scalar instance.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required: No zero coordinate may be divided out at ramification or infinity; the degree chart must be the full preimage.
obligations.constructed: Finite q0 and infinity q1 coefficients are units on the whole respective charts. SourceGlobalAffine318.chartEmbedding_range identifies the full preimage of the t-chart.
obligations.why_match: The ratio formulas retain z_i=0 and u=0. IsOpenImmersion.isPullback uses the actual range equality, so the degree input is not only a dense map or field heuristic.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.required: All allowed twists, branch indices, zero-section and constant-ratio possibilities must be handled.
obligations.constructed: The claims hold for all c:Fin4→Qˣ. Nonzero rational twists exclude exactly the divisions used. Polynomial evaluation is injective on every branch ring.
obligations.why_match: A relation a*q0+b*q1=0 forces a=b=0, so neither section nor their span degenerates. No assertion in positive characteristic or for zero twists is added.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: The actual base-point-free pair needs a projective map, independence, and an object-bound generic degree statement.
obligations.constructed: projectiveMap is finite/proper and equals modelMap; actual pair is rationally independent; actual cartesian t-chart is finite free rank16 with specified generic fiber of dimension16.
obligations.why_match: This closes these intrinsic geometric inputs only. Complete-linear-system, genus, O(1)-pullback identification, Shimura twist selection, PEL, KS and metric/height inputs are not inferred.

consumer: Intrinsic section-defined projective map and its specified degree input. Not a PEL/KS, genus, complete-linear-system, or height producer.
degree_scope: Exact entire t-chart cartesian square; finite-free rank16 coordinate algebra there; specified Q(t)-generic-fiber algebra equivalence to original Raw field of dimension16. No numeric Scheme-degree API or global all-chart locally-free-rank theorem added.
